claim_ceiling: r002 design/cases candidate, second of maximum three review rounds; no frozen contract, runner RED, production Builder admission or acceptance

runner_contract.compile: esbuild.transform source bytes to CJS in memory; vm allowlist loader; no drawChart/constructor/destroy body copies, source rewrites or universal Proxy
runner_contract.execution_error_policy: compiler/import/unknown seam/timeout/fixture invalid = execution_error; cannot count as expected RED
runner_contract.phase_projection: Only external resource-release calls occurring inside production destroy invocation and line catch; constructor acquisition/start pre-destroy calls have separate acquisition trace. Exact order/multiplicity; no dedup.

error_policy.business: reject same object/value E; no wrapper
error_policy.carousel_destroy: return void on clean; after all attempts throw first raw cleanup error, console.warn each remaining raw error once in attempt order
error_policy.constructor_and_line: consume destroy first error and warn it once, then rethrow business original; line G.destroy error warn once after C cleanup. Therefore multi-error warning order C[1:] then C[0] then G error.
error_policy.console_warn_failure: best effort swallow logger failure; no recursive reporting
error_policy.case_identity: raw fixture bytes + canonical cases array + runner bytes + input production bytes; freeze before RED, same runner/Cases for GREEN; production bytes may change only by approved Builder

fixture_rules: Fresh vm/module state and NamedClock per case. Clock starts now_ms=0, next_handle=1, no timers/frames, no observer callback delivered unless case startup_plan says so; no wall clock or automatic timer firing. Every allocation has numeric handle, due time, callback source, owner, registry entry; symbolic TQ/TN maps to the concrete handle in startup_plan.

Ordinary line start with visibility pending uses real constructor then real start: next checks !chartIsVisible and returns before tooltip scheduling, then drainStartQueue acquires 40ms TQ handle 1. This is legitimate pending IntersectionObserver delivery, not a private field override. start-entered=true; tooltip show count=0.

Visible controls use real constructor/start with pending observer (TQ0 handle1 due40), deliver actual captured visible IO callback (queues C behind TQ0), advance exactly 40ms. Production cooldown callback drains queue: line/area/pie next executes without own nextItem; bar/mix waitForRenderedElements acquires TN handle2 due200 and then TQ handle3 due80. Never set isFirstColumnFrameReady, chartIsVisible, isExecuting or queue/cache/timer fields to fabricate this startup.

For multi-owner cases every construct/start/replacement/IO/clock action is explicit in startup_plan. Chart metadata id equals its logical container to keep actual checkStopOnViewChange prefix empty, so constructors do not accidentally stop other owners. Independent NamedChart, DOM host, wrapper, observer identities are listed. Same logical container replacement changes DOM/wrapper lookup only at the named action; prior ledger holds prior target.

Only explicit inject_owned_resources stress cases may install synthetic owned S/TI/TN/TH/F/B resources. Allocate each through named fake registry before assigning its declared field, after genuine constructor/start; do not replace a preexisting live same-field resource or bypass first-frame/start flow. These remain cleanup primitive fault fixtures, not evidence of ordinary timer acquisition.

Target add/remove records exact callback and capture; throw-after-effect means registry applied the primitive then threw. Clear throw-before-effect keeps explicit unresolved resource. Unknown dependency/export, compile failure, timeout, missing step, or unregistered handle is execution_error.

Only production source transpilation and three declared transparent observation spies allowed. Startup APIs and clock callbacks execute production methods; no alternate constructor/start/destroy/stop/clearTimer/waitForRenderedElements implementation or universal Proxy.

observation_spies.rule: Record entry then call saved compiled-production original exactly once with same this/args and return/throw unchanged. No fault injection or replacement control flow in these spies; constructor/start/destroy/stop/clearTimer remain unwrapped production bodies. Labels chart.restoreColumnSelectionAttributes:G/chart.clearInteractionBackgrounds:G identify Carousel helper entry using its G handle, not invented methods on NamedChart.

startup_assertions_required: execute each startup_plan.steps in order; pre-subject owners/global/registry must match declared snapshots before reset trace
No implicit start/IO delivery/clock tick/seed-owner added by scenario name
Actual registry after each setTimeout/clear/firing checked; C.start pending visibility may early-return next without suppressing cooldown
first-column TN must be acquired through production waitForRenderedElements with real interval datum, never a private field assignment
every retained/new owner has exact queue order, timer registry, cache identity, listener/observer identity and visual emissions checked
LSC-039 does not use final caught object as its expected reference; reference-equality proof explicitly not claimed

invariants: C lifecycle flags, listeners, observer, timer/frame/cancel/background refs consumed before external cleanup; reentrant destroy no-op
listener registration intent recorded before add using original target/handler/capture; thrown add may have applied
cache detach occurs at destroy entry before any reentrant cleanup primitive, only if cache.get(container)===this; old owner never deletes new owner; tail performs no container-key cache delete
global timers/listener state detached before remove/clear; release only cache empty; no container-key resize task deletion
never promise physical cleanup success after cleanup primitive throws-before-effect; record unresolved resources
G.destroy once for every returned G handle on drawChart failure; C constructor handles own partial resources before it can return
success no premature cleanup; caller owns returned G; empty no G allocation
real permissions and stage/query/Store/installer-before-return obligations remain open
